key_findings: Neutrophil-derived NGF acting on TrkA in TRPV1+ nociceptors initiates nociceptive ingrowth after bone injury
Nociceptors, via CGRP-driven osteoblast autophagy, promote LXA4 production to resolve neutrophilic inflammation and enable bone repair
